      change (T.comp R') w - (T.comp R) w = 0
      rw [hR', h]
      simp
    have hsum : R' = R + J := by
      ext w
      simp [J]
    refine ⟨J, ⟨hJ, hsum⟩, ?_⟩
    intro J' hJ'
    ext w
    have heq := LinearMap.congr_fun hJ'.2 w
    have heq0 := LinearMap.congr_fun hsum w
    change R' w = R w + J' w at heq
    change R' w = R w + J w at heq0
    exact add_left_cancel (heq.symm.trans heq0)
  · rintro ⟨J, ⟨hJ, hEq⟩, _⟩
    rw [hEq]
    ext w
    have h1 : T (R w) = w := by
      simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun h w
    have h0 : T (J w) = 0 := by
      simpa using LinearMap.congr_fun hJ w
    change T (R w + J w) = w
    rw [map_add, h1, h0]
    simp
